All independent evidence agrees on *Homo sapiens*; the `scientificName` string "Mus musculus" is a field-level corruption in the returned record, not a genuine rodent assignment. Note the plain-text (`.txt`) record reproduces the same corruption in the `OS` line (`OS Mus musculus (Human).`), suggesting the fault is upstream in the served record rather than in one serialization format.
